ImageDescription.value:
Ceramic tiles displayed along "Tensile Membrane" by Mark Thomas elevated pedestrian walkway at Reisterstown Plaza station in Baltimore, Maryland, United States. The walkway connects the parking lots off Wabash Avenue to Reisterstown Plaza station. This artwork was commissioned by the Maryland Transit Administration and installed in 2003 as a replacement to Rockne Krebs's 1986 work "Vine Covered Passerelle," which deteriorated due to unexpected severe weather.

The ceramic tiles displayed along the walkway were painted by students at a nearby elementary school.

Taken on November 13, 2021; edited/adjusted on November 21, 2021.
